scope: Existing eight Services/dashboard/lifecycle boundaries with a retained authenticated account. Login is a separate prerequisite, not repeated inside either measured arm.
cutoff: Freeze the writer-backed prefix at service-list-reactivated. Preserve its exact bytes and expected identities. Keep the same process foreground for ordinary upload; never flush, relaunch, add a Home step or change tracking configuration. Preserve and classify the later capture tail separately.
semantic_contract: Signed-in entry preserves the eight source-defined Services/dashboard/lifecycle phases. It omits only the three login phases and LoginWithSubdomainTapped; the ordinary login mode remains unchanged.
Every view occurrence and mapper revision remains in raw local evidence; current backend view versions may supersede earlier versions.
Require each behavior-prefix action/resource/error/long-task identity and exact owner in backend; no same-name replacement.

Compare Browser/native application and session, separate Browser source/service/SDK/view identity, and exact eligible native container. Replay ineligible is explicit missing container coverage, not an SDK regression.
Keep incidental metadata, counters and reducer updates for inspection without requiring complete payload equality or session closure.
Post-cutoff events cannot supply missing behavior-prefix events. Same-process foreground uploader activity is allowed and separately classified.
Candidate admission requires complete baseline mechanism, frozen mode/source/product/helpers/cutoff and timely cleanup; final paired source review still owns F08 closure.
budget_basis: Remove181second duplicate expiry wait and two excess Home steps from the old2700second mode. Preserve existing per-step180, authentication600, backend600 and cleanup300 bounds prospectively; no existing deadline changes.
recorder_cost_contract: Preserve every cost and unchanged historical thresholds as separate diagnostics. A cost overrun alone does not invalidate correctness; missing or inconsistent capture, consumed readiness, deadline failure or unresolved semantic ambiguity still blocks acceptance. No performance claim.

account_contract.setup: Corrected signed baseline, same device/bundle/keychain group, observed selected organization/profile and real Services row; recorder disabled. No credential export.
account_contract.capture: First planned baseline freezes typed non-null usr.id and usr.org_uuid as salted comparison digests at the first Services boundary; candidate must match before service-detail input.
account_contract.retention: Only the exact task main process may be stopped. In-place install preserves account and data. Archive only recorder-owned files, retain unrelated Documents bytes, and never uninstall/reset the app.
account_contract.cleanup: Preserve current capture, prove task process/workers absent, retain the exact installed product, unchanged non-task app inventory and display. Retention PASS is required before candidate admission.
